# Recorded firing sounds

All twelve clips are excerpts from **The Free Firearm Sound Library**, recorded by Ben Jaszczak, Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras and Matthew Nanney. The creators released the recordings under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). [Library release](https://opengameart.org/content/the-free-firearm-sound-library) · [recording catalog](https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/blob/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/Prepared%20Master%20Sheet.csv) · [source license](https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/blob/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/LICENSE)

Each file contains one recorded report and its natural reflections. The edits select one microphone from the original stereo pair, trim silence, set gain, and fade the cut edges. The clips are 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit PCM. Each second take comes from a separate discharge within the same recording.
